objective: Make every retained spot from the existing 100-mile NYC public-place workbook available on the map and through the Spots list, then add current women-centered queer venues found from current public sources under their normal spot categories without exposing a special audience label.
userOutcome: The Spots map contains the complete retained 100-mile NYC workbook dataset, the Spots list continues beyond the first 50 results, and current women-centered queer venues appear as bars, community spaces, shops, or cafes without being called dyke spots.
audience: cruush members browsing Spots within 100 miles of New York City.
successCriteria: All 3,717 retained workbook rows are represented by idempotent published place records using only factual name, coordinates, public category, and source identity fields.
Copied source descriptions, access instructions, popularity history, and visitor data are not imported.
The Spots list automatically continues past its first 50 results without forcing members to find a manual load button.
Current independently sourced women-centered queer venues inside the 100-mile radius are included under their normal facility categories.
No visible category, filter, card, or spot detail calls these venues dyke spots.
People clusters, spot clusters, map tiles, map theme, and unrelated map behavior remain unchanged.
mustPreserve: Preserve the approved custom map tiles and theme exactly.
Preserve the existing separate people and spot cluster behavior.
Preserve existing published spot records, check-ins, Pink Book posts, ratings, vibes, amenities, and unrelated 1.6 work.
Keep imported source rows limited to the prior workbook's public-access retained set.
nonGoals: Do not scrape Sniffies again, copy its descriptions, import access codes, import private residences, import visitor history, add a new public audience category, change spot cards, add tests, build the app, update email screenshots, push, or deploy.
Do not change map pin visuals, cluster visuals, map navigation, filters, or adjacent pages.

assumptions.statement: The existing user-controlled workbook is the requested prior Sniffies-derived 100-mile NYC dataset.
assumptions.impact: The import is generated from its 3,717 retained rows without a new competitor scrape.

assumptions.statement: Respective categories means existing facility categories such as Bar, Community space, Shop, and Cafe, not a new public audience label.
assumptions.impact: Women-centered venues remain discoverable as ordinary Spots without the rejected label.

nextVisibleMilestone: A scoped commit containing the generated place migration, sourced venue additions, and automatic list continuation.
stopConditions: Stop if the source workbook cannot be read, a retained row lies outside 100 miles, generated SQL cannot preserve the existing place schema, or a named file has conflicting user edits.

externalEffectDecisions.commit: authorized by the standing request to commit while completing the 1.6 todo

job: Generate the scoped spot migrations, make list pagination automatic, and checkpoint commit.
proofTarget: Generated-row audit showing exactly 3,717 unique retained workbook records within 100 miles, source review for added venues, and source inspection of automatic progressive list pagination.
requiredEvidence: The generated migration has exactly 3,717 unique workbook-backed records and contains no copied descriptions or visit-history fields.
Each added women-centered venue has a current public source and lies within 100 miles of the NYC center.
The first 50 list results automatically request the next page when the continuation sentinel enters view.
